card.name: Small words before peak or bottom levels
card.fires_on: Small linking words (at, below, to, hitting) that come right before a peak, low point or level such as 'at bay', 'at its peak', or 'rock bottom'.

modes.label: Preposition before peak/level
modes.description: 'at', 'below' or 'to' placed just before a high or low point or a level.
modes.example: the city contained over a million inhabitants<< at>> its peak.

modes.label: Verb or participle before a low point
modes.description: A verb like hitting or plunged leading into a bottom or low value.
modes.example: our sense of happiness starts to decline,<< hitting>> rock bottom in our mid-40

modes.label: Other scattered linking words
modes.description: Words like have, me or having in ordinary sentences with no peak wording.
modes.example: The experience has given<< me>> a new appreciation of the training, skill

card.writes: It suppresses 'peak' and 'network' words, so it steers the next word away from peak or network.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a phrase like 'at its peak' or 'rock bottom' and pushes the model away from predicting 'peak'.
